title: Ex3 - MC: Multi-line plot code
text:
Which code correctly plots total_profit and facecream as two separate lines against month_number?

A) plt.plot(df['month_number'], df['total_profit'])
   plt.plot(df['month_number'], df['facecream'])

B) plt.multiplot(df['month_number'], [df['total_profit'], df['facecream']])

C) plt.plot(df[['total_profit', 'facecream']])

D) plt.line(df['month_number'], df['total_profit'], df['facecream'])
